card.name: Imperative verbs directing the prescriber
card.fires_on: The word right after an instruction verb aimed at the clinician, such as Inform, Instruct, Advise, resume, assess or be alert. It also fires on the start of a drug name after resume.

modes.label: Object after instruction verb
modes.description: The word that follows Inform, Instruct or Advise, usually patients or the.
modes.example: 2.4 Important Administration Instructions Inform<< patients>> and their caregiver(s) which ZEP

modes.label: Drug name after resume
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name right after the verb resume.
modes.example: resume<< t>>adalafil at 20 mg once daily

modes.label: Clinician action verb
modes.description: A verb telling the prescriber to act, such as assess, refer or be alert.
modes.example: throughout treatment,<< assess>> each patient’s risk for abuse, misuse

card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where the text tells the prescriber what to do, such as inform, instruct or assess.
